caseName: Allen & Co., Inc. v. Pacific Dunlop Holdings Inc
caseNameFull: Allen & Co., Inc. v. Pacific Dunlop Holdings Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, March 4, 1994. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, April 1, 1994. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on *1084 or before 3 p.m., Friday, April 15, 1994. This Court’s Rule 29 does not apply.
